preregistration.summary: Solved in outline before opening runs/. Justa causa under CLT 482 k is not viable: (i) imediatidade broken — Renata's e-mail of 21/08/2026 08:51 ('Viu o post dela ontem?') shows the preposta knew of the 20/08 post the next morning; the request came 07/10 (47 days) and the pedido 11/10 (51 days); the library says preposto knowledge is employer knowledge and delay means perdão tácito; (ii) tipicidade/gravidade — generic criticism of working conditions, no personal offence, and the fact is true (prontuário: 62h weekend hours in banco de horas, unpaid); (iii) proporcionalidade — no prior warnings in 5+ years. Two stabilities: gestante (atestado 18/09/2026, 9 weeks; ADCT 10 II b; Súmula 244 I makes the manager's ignorance irrelevant; DPP ~23/04/2027 so ~23/09/2027) and CIPA suplente (ata: eleita 12/05/2026, posse 02/06/2026, 1-year mandate; ADCT 10 II a; Súmula 339 I; CLT 165 — ~jun/2028). Dispensa sem justa causa during the stabilities is void (reintegração) so the pushback alternative must be rejected. Exposure = verbas (aviso 45d = 11,700; 13º and férias proporcionais; 40% FGTS) + indemnity for the stability period + dano moral (library range R$ 5–20k; 223-G caps).

cross_run_observations: All five runs reach the correct conclusion (justa causa not viable), identify both stabilities with the right library authorities, anchor imediatidade on the 21/08 e-mail, reject dispensa sem justa causa during the guarantees, and respond to the pushback in a dedicated section; no run has a trust-fatal event and every cited authority is in INDEX.md (out-of-library items were consistently labelled 'não verificado'). The runs separate mainly on exposure method: C and E land inside the key's ±20% band (212.6k / 213.3k), A and D exceed it (240.3k / 243.5k) only because they indemnify the longer CIPA guarantee, which is legally the better reading and which the key itself identifies, and B cumulates the two overlapping guarantee periods (318.0k), double-paying ~11 months — the only substantive analytical error observed, disclosed by the run as unverified. Because the key's 111,535 indemnity corresponds to the shorter gestante window, the exposure oracle was pre-registered as diagnostic. Trap 4 is unprompted in every run by the protocol's timing rule (pushback is a work turn); B and D demonstrably anticipated it before the pushback. Three runs (B, D, E) asked questions that released 'gravidez' and 'horas'; A asked nothing and C asked non-triggering questions; all five derived the 21/08 knowledge date from the documents without needing 'quando_soube'.
